Fix a confirmed DRY/drift-risk finding from a postbuild audit of SFCC-236 on branch `feature/SFCC-236_product-card-shared-component` in `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa`. This is a pure extraction refactor — zero behavioural change, no value may change, only where each value is DEFINED changes (from independently-retyped literal to a shared imported constant).

**The problem:** the build plan (`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmerMANN-skills/.runs/SFCC-236/plan.md`, §3) named a file, `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/zimmProductCardShared.ts`, meant to hold two things so they're defined exactly once: the ten `data-card-slot` attribute values used to wire hover/reveal CSS to specific DOM nodes, and the `HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY` media-query string used to gate hover-only behaviour. That file was never created. Right now both are hand-retyped as raw string literals in multiple files, synchronized only by a comment saying "don't rename this without updating that file too."

**The precedent to mirror exactly** (read it first): `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/zimmColourSwatchGroupShared.ts` — a tiny file, one exported const, a one-line comment explaining where the value came from. Match that scale and simplicity — do not over-engineer this into a large module.

**Step 1 — create the new file** `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/zimmProductCardShared.ts`, exporting:
- A `CARD_SLOT` object (or equivalent — use your judgement on the cleanest idiomatic shape, e.g. `export const CARD_SLOT = { media: 'media', badge: 'badge', close: 'close', carousel: 'carousel', indicator: 'indicator', content: 'content', bag: 'bag', price: 'price', sizeChips: 'sizeChips', notifyMe: 'notifyMe' } as const;`) covering exactly these ten values — confirmed by direct grep, do not add or remove any: `media`, `badge`, `close`, `carousel`, `indicator`, `content`, `bag`, `price`, `sizeChips`, `notifyMe`.
- `HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY = '@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)'` (the exact current value — verify it against both existing copies before typing it, they must already agree).

**Step 2 — update every producer and consumer to import from it instead of retyping:**
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/index.tsx` — every `data-card-slot="..."` JSX attribute (currently: media, close, carousel, indicator, badge) becomes `data-card-slot={CARD_SLOT.x}`.
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardContent/index.tsx` — same, for its own slots (bag, content, price, sizeChips, notifyMe).
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/zimmProductCardMedia.css.ts` — replace its own private `HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY` definition with an import of the shared one. Check whether it also has any `data-card-slot` selector strings of its own and convert those too if so.
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/zimmProductCard.css.ts` — replace its own private `HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY` definition with an import of the shared one. Replace every `data-card-slot="x"` occurrence inside its CSS-in-JS selector strings (there are 17+) with a template literal referencing `CARD_SLOT.x`, e.g. `` `[data-card-slot="${CARD_SLOT.carousel}"]` ``.
- The three test files that currently hardcode `[data-card-slot="..."]` inside `querySelector(...)` calls — `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/index.test.tsx`, `.../zimmProductCardMedia/index.test.tsx`, `.../zimmProductCardContent/index.test.tsx` — update these to import `CARD_SLOT` too and build the same template-literal selector, for the same reason (a test re-typing the literal defeats the point of centralising it).

**Do not touch anything else.** No unrelated fixes, no new features, no renaming beyond what's described, no change to any component's actual rendered output or any test's actual assertions beyond how the selector string is constructed. Every value must remain byte-identical to what it is today — verify this before and after (e.g. `grep -c 'data-card-slot="carousel"'` should show the same total occurrences of the value `"carousel"` somewhere in the codebase before and after, just relocated from a literal to `CARD_SLOT.carousel`).

**Register nothing new in `theme/components/index.ts`** — this file exports plain constants, it is not a Chakra recipe.

When done, report exactly which files you touched and confirm `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean. Do not run the full test suite yourself, do not stage, do not commit — just report back what you changed.

2	
3	**Generated:** 2026-09-02 · **Planner:** `zm-planner` (Opus) · **Gate:** [findings.md](./findings.md)
4	**STATUS: GATE PASSED — ready for `zimmerMANNBuild`.** All blocking questions resolved; Tier 2 crossing approved

6	**Scope: SFCC-236 only.** SFCC-83 and SFCC-84 are held — blocked on data source, surface list, and Legal's consent ruling.
7	
8	---
9	
10	## 1. Goal
11	
12	Build the shared Zimmermann Product Card per SFCC-236 (8 pts, Sprint 4, epic SFCC-2), designed in Figma
13	`wPiWmZZOVKnrENUWk2XWWm` set `40000223:2822` (20 variants: Size × State × Type × Unavailable), following the
14	FED handbook's ui-kits atomic layering and the PR #64 / `zimmColourSwatchGroup` pattern — named-export
15	component reading a `Zimm*`-namespaced multipart recipe via `useMultiStyleConfig`, parts applied with
16	`<chakra.div __css={styles.x}>`, all values `var(--zimm-*)` with explicit media queries.
17	
18	**The card is the visual layer only:** every value arrives as a prop, it owns no data fetching, and it renders
19	the add-to-bag / size-selection controls without wiring their behaviour (SFCC-185 / SFCC-497 / SFCC-90).

23	## 2. Scale call — one branch, seven commits, one PR
24	
25	```bash
26	git fetch origin && git checkout -b feature/SFCC-236_product-card-shared-component origin/develop
27	```
28	
29	The current checkout (`feature/SFCC-91_...`) is merged and must not be built on.
30	
31	**Why one branch despite ~24 files:** one component family, one Figma set, one ticket, one reviewer set
32	(`pwa-squad-a` + `pwa-squad-b` on every file). The molecules have exactly one consumer — the organism — so
33	merging them separately merges dead code. Splitting would also multiply the single Tier 2 touch
34	(`theme/components/index.ts`) across three approval cycles for an append-only registry edit.
35

37	wrong prop contract propagates into eight downstream stories.

41	| Dropped | Why |
42	|---|---|
43	| Copy-first | Nothing to copy — no file is being overridden at a mirrored path |
44	| Playwright / `.feature` | No page renders this component on this branch; E2E belongs to SFCC-80/90/497 |
45	| Bundle-size / LCP step | Nothing imports the card yet; bundle delta is zero |
46	| Visual regression | Chromatic/Loki is out of budget (`testing.md` excludes it); hover fidelity is a manual Storybook check |
47	| Multi-region fixtures | The card takes pre-formatted strings; no locale/currency logic to vary |

84	"no Tier 1 file is touched," which is no longer true.
85	
86	### Created (21) — all Tier 3/4, `pwa-squad-a` + `pwa-squad-b`
87	
88	Root `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/`, each with `index.tsx` · `index.stories.tsx` · `index.test.tsx` · `<name>.css.ts`:
89	
90	```
91	molecules/zimmSlideIndicator/
92	atoms/zimmSizeChip/
93	molecules/zimmSizeChipGroup/
94	molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/
95	molecules/zimmProductCardContent/
96	organisms/zimmProductCard/          + zimmProductCardShared.ts
97	```
98	
99	**Explicitly NOT created: `overrides/app/components/product-tile/`** — creating it activates the resolver for
100	PLP, Search, Home, Cart, PDP and empty-search-results, and `product-list/index.jsx:51-53` imports
101	`{Skeleton as ProductTileSkeleton}`, so an override without that named export breaks PLP at import time.
102	
103	`zimmProductCardShared.ts` holds DOM-contract constants (`data-card-slot` names) + `CARD_BP` derived from
104	`theme/foundation/gridSystem`. No design values, so it stays co-located (precedent:
105	`zimmColourSwatchGroupShared.ts`). Keeps the Tier 2 surface at exactly one file.
106	
107	---
108	
109	## 4. Architecture decisions
110	
111	**Variation axis = discriminated union (data contract) + declarative config table (layout).**
112	`typescript.md` mandates the union, and the ACs require it: Wishlist alone needs `colour` + `size` + mandatory
113	`onRemove`; PLP alone needs `sizes` + `onNotifyMe`. A flat optional-everything bag lets you build a Wishlist
114	card with no remove CTA (AC violation) and a PLP card with one (design violation).
115	
116	```
117	ZimmProductCardProps = Base & (PlpVariation | HomeVariation | WishlistVariation)
118	  base:       id, href, name, headingLevel, primaryImage, hoverImage?, images?,
119	              currentPrice?, originalPrice?, isUnavailable?, badge?
120	  'plp':      sizes?, selectedSize?, onSizeSelect?, onAddToBag?, onNotifyMe?
121	  'home':     —
122	  'wishlist': colour, size, onRemove (required), onAddToBag?
123	```
124	
125	`'recently-viewed'` is **not** a fourth member — the AC says it behaves identically to PLP, so consumers pass
126	`variation: 'plp'`. Recorded as an assumption, not a silent choice.
127	
128	The render body must **not** `switch` on `props.variation`. Layout comes from a module-level `VARIATION_CONFIG`
129	(`showBag`, `showAttributes`, `showRemove`, `hoverHidesPrice`, `hoverRevealsPrice`, `hoverRevealsSizeSelector`,
130	`hoverSwapsImage`). That is what satisfies the extensibility AC: add a union member + a config row, touch no JSX.
131	
132	**The card is fluid, not 288px.** `gridSystem.ts` has `maxWidth: 'none'`. Figma's 288/179 are widths at the
133	reference artboards. The card fills its grid cell (`width: 100%`); the image holds ratio via `aspectRatio`.
134	Grid placement belongs to SFCC-80.
135	
136	**Mobile/desktop boundary = 768px** (`breakpoints.md`, 48em) — the only confirmed foundation breakpoint between
137	the 402 and 1440 artboards, and where the grid already goes 4→8 columns. `min-width` is inclusive, so the 768
138	artboard gets the desktop card. Every hover rule is additionally gated on `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`
139	so a 768px touch tablet never gets hover-only content. See OQ-5.
140	
141	**Hover is CSS-only, keyed on `:hover, :focus-within`.** No React hover state — 60 tiles re-rendering on pointer
142	move is a PLP perf defect. `:focus-within` is not optional: WCAG 2.2 AA requires the revealed size selector and
143	arrows be keyboard-reachable. All reveal selectors live in one place, the organism's recipe root part, selecting
144	descendants by the shared `data-card-slot` constants. Molecules stay hover-agnostic.
145	
146	**One link per card (stretched-link).** The card holds a bag button, arrows, size options and a remove button —
147	nesting those in an `<a>` is invalid HTML and an a11y failure. The link wraps the product name only and carries
148	a `::after { position:absolute; inset:0 }` overlay; controls get `position:relative; z-index:1`. `href` arrives
149	pre-prefixed from the page. Uses `import {Link as RouteLink} from 'react-router-dom'` per `zimmColourSwatch` —
150	there is no `overrides/app/components/link/` override, contrary to a claim in `overrideStyling.md`.
151	
152	**Reuse, don't rebuild:** `ZimmProductName`, `ZimmProductPrice`, `ZimmIcon` (`bag`, `close`, `chevron-left`,
153	`chevron-right` all exist in `ICON_MAP`). No new icons.
154	
155	**VIC pricing is not a card concern** — precedence is the page mapper's job. Deferred to SFCC-778 (OQ-6).
156	
157	---
158	
159	## 4a. Arrows vs. indicator — RESOLVED (Marcel, 2026-09-02)
160	
161	> *"position indicator is just for tablet and mobile, desktop hover is arrows"*
162	
163	The two are **mutually exclusive**, not paired. Consequences for Steps 1 and 4:
164	
165	**Split by pointer capability, not viewport width.** The gate is
166	`@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)` — the same gate every other hover rule already uses:
167	
168	- **hover-capable + fine pointer** → prev/next arrow buttons, revealed on `:hover, :focus-within`. No indicator.
169	- **everything else (touch tablet, mobile)** → `ZimmSlideIndicator`, always visible. No arrows.
170	
171	Capability rather than width is what actually delivers the stated intent: the 768 artboard is a *touch* tablet,
172	and a width rule alone would give it arrows it can never hover to reveal. It also keeps this consistent with the
173	card's own hover rules rather than introducing a second, differently-keyed breakpoint. **Edge case, accepted:**
174	a desktop browser resized below 768 keeps arrows (it still has a fine pointer); a touch-screen laptop gets the
175	indicator. Both are the safe failure direction — nobody is shown a control they cannot operate.
176	
177	**Two knock-on changes to the step pass criteria:**
178	
179	1. **Step 1 — the indicator is NOT `aria-hidden` on touch.** The original criterion assumed the arrow buttons
180	   announce position, so the indicator could be hidden as duplicate. Where the indicator renders there are **no
181	   arrows**, so it becomes the only position signal — hiding it would be a 1.1.1 information loss. It needs an
182	   accessible position announcement (e.g. a visually-hidden "Image 3 of 8" live region, or `role="group"` with
183	   `aria-label`). Revised criterion: exposed and announced when it is the sole affordance.
184	2. **Step 4 — mobile image paging has no mechanism and no AC.** If the indicator shows position on touch, some
185	   touch gesture must change the image. No AC covers this; the ACs only describe desktop hover. See OQ-11.
186	
187	---
188	
189	## 4b. Touch image paging — RESOLVED (Marcel, 2026-09-02)
190	
191	> *"scroll-snap it is"*
192	
193	Native CSS scroll-snap. The dots remain a **passive readout**, visually unchanged from Figma — no enlargement,
194	no conversion to tap targets, so no departure from the design and no WCAG 2.5.8 problem to solve.
195	
196	**Implementation shape: one scroll container on every breakpoint, not two mechanisms.**
197	
198	The image strip is always a horizontally scrollable flex container with `scrollSnapType: 'x mandatory'` and
199	`scrollSnapAlign: 'start'` on each slide. What differs by pointer capability is only the *affordance* layered
200	over it:
201	
202	| | Mechanism | Affordance |
203	|---|---|---|
204	| hover + fine pointer | same scroll container | arrows call `scrollBy()`; no indicator |
205	| touch | same scroll container | native drag; indicator reflects position |
206	
207	One container rather than two code paths means a single source of truth for "which image is showing", the
208	arrows become progressive enhancement over something that already works, and the desktop path inherits
209	keyboard scrollability for free.
210	
211	**Active-index derivation:** prefer `IntersectionObserver` on the slides over a scroll listener — 60 tiles on a
212	PLP make a per-scroll-event listener a real perf cost, and the repo already has
213	`overrides/app/hooks/use-intersection-observer.ts` (**Tier 2 — import it, do not modify it**). The `scrollend`
214	event is an acceptable alternative. Left to the Implementer; either satisfies the pass criteria.
215	
216	**Precedent:** the base `ProductScroller`
217	(`node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/product-scroller/index.jsx:79-84`) already uses
218	`scrollSnapType: 'x mandatory'` with `overflowX: 'scroll'`. Same technique, already proven in this codebase.
219	
220	**Accepted caveat:** swipe has no explicit affordance beyond the dots implying further content. This is the
221	universal mobile convention, and the alternative (enlarging 1px dots into 24×24 tap targets) trades an
222	invisible-but-expected gesture for a visible-but-off-design control. **Action: flag to Kiera that the mobile
223	gesture is undocumented in the design**, so it lands in the spec rather than being discovered in QA.
224	
225	**Added Step 4 pass criteria:**
226	- The slide container carries `scrollSnapType: 'x mandatory'`; every slide carries `scrollSnapAlign`.
227	- Arrows are rendered only under `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`; the indicator only outside it; assert the
228	  two never coexist in the same DOM.
229	- Arrow activation moves the scroll position (assert `scrollBy`/`scrollTo` is called — jsdom does not lay out,
230	  so assert the call, not the resulting offset).
231	- The indicator's active index tracks the observed slide, and clamps at both ends.
232	- A single-image product renders no indicator, no arrows, and no horizontal overflow.
233	- No gesture library is added — `package.json` is untouched (AGENTS.md Hard Rule #7).
234	
235	---
236	
237	## 4c. Badge — RESOLVED (Marcel, 2026-09-02), and it corrects the decomposition
238	
239	Nine nodes supplied; all resolve off one parent, `40001471:20702` "Badge" (a documentation board).
240	`40001471:20682` is its cover slide, not a component.
241	
242	**There are TWO badge components, not one:**
243	
244	| Component set | Node | Variants | Size |
245	|---|---|---|---|
246	| **`Badge`** | `40001471:20752` | `State=Primary` (`…20751`) · `State=Hover` (`…20750`) | 33×15 |
247	| **`Stock Status Badge`** | `40001796:7041` | `State=Available` (`…7040`) · `State=Unavailable` (`…7039`) · `State=Low stock` (`…7038`) | 66–79×20 |
248	
249	`Stock Status Badge` appears in **no acceptance criterion**. It maps to `.docs/prd/plp.md` §3
250	("**OUT OF STOCK** shown on tile when all sizes are at or below buffer threshold" and the low-stock
251	indicator) — so the PRD requirement that had no design **does** have one. Its `Low stock` state
252	corresponds to nothing in any AC, and `plp.md` §3 places low-stock *at size level*, not on the tile.
253	
254	### Decomposition correction — three slots move from Content to Media
255	
256	Reading `Image Group / Size=Large` (`40002742:46322`, 288×432) and `Size=Small` (`40002742:46321`,
257	179×268) shows the overlays live on the **image**, not in the text block:
258	
259	| Slot | Frame | Structure | Desktop | Mobile |
260	|---|---|---|---|---|
261	| **`Tag`** (the badge) | 78×48 @ top-left | `touchContainer` 30×24 @ (24,12) → `Label` text 30×8 | ✅ | ✅ |
262	| **`Close`** (remove 'x') | 48×48 @ top-right | `touchContainer` 24×24 → `Icon` 16×16 | ✅ | ✅ |
263	| **`Carousel`** (arrows) | 288×24 @ y=204 (vertically centred) | two `touchContainer` 24×24 @ x=12 and x=252 | ✅ | **absent** |
264	| **`Slide-indicator`** | 179×1, flush to the image's bottom edge (y=267 of 268) | instance | **absent** | ✅ |
265	
266	**Consequences:**
267	
268	1. **The badge slot moves from Step 5 to Step 4.** It is `Tag`, overlaid top-left on the image — not a part
269	   of `Card-content`. Remove the `badge` part from `zimmProductCardContent.css.ts`; add a `tag` part to
270	   `zimmProductCardMedia.css.ts`.
271	2. **The remove ('x') CTA moves from Step 5 to Step 4.** It is `Close`, top-right on the image. The plan had
272	   it in `ZimmProductCardContent` — wrong molecule. Remove `onRemove` handling from Content; it belongs in
273	   Media. The union still carries `onRemove` on the wishlist member; the organism passes it to Media.
274	3. **This makes the split cleaner, not messier:** everything overlaid on the image is Media, everything below
275	   it is Content.
276	4. **§4a and §4b are confirmed by the design itself,** not just by the verbal decision — `Size=Large` has
277	   `Carousel` and no indicator; `Size=Small` has `Slide-indicator` and no `Carousel`.
278	5. **The slide indicator is a 1px hairline flush to the image's bottom edge**, not floating dots. Step 1's
279	   recipe must not assume dot geometry.
280	
281	### Two new findings that need raising, not resolving in code
282	
283	- **🟡 The badge looks interactive, against a requirement that says it must not be.** `Tag` wraps its label in
284	  a **`touchContainer`** — this file's convention for an interactive hit area (the bag icon and both arrows use
285	  the identical wrapper) — and the `Badge` component ships a **`State=Hover`**. But SPR-16 reads
286	  "~~clickable~~ product badges" and `.docs/prd/plp.md:70` says clickable badges are *"a NEW unsigned request —
287	  not confirmed… **Do not implement**."* Two independent signals in Figma versus an explicit written
288	  prohibition. **Build it non-interactive per the requirement** (a plain element, no button, no hover rule),
289	  and raise the discrepancy — do not resolve it in code.
290	- **🔵 `Icons OLD`.** The `Carousel` arrows in the current card design instance icons named
291	  `Icons OLD` (`40003066:50796`, `40003066:50798`). Deprecated naming inside a live component. Flag to Kiera.
292	- **🔵 The card's `Tag` does not instance the `Badge` component.** `Tag`'s child is a raw `Label` text node
293	  (30×8), not an instance of `40001471:20752` (33×15). The design system has a Badge component the card
294	  doesn't use. Ask which is authoritative before styling the slot.
295	
296	### Revised Step 4 pass criteria (additions)
297	
298	- `Tag` renders top-left when `badge` is supplied, as static text with no button/hover rule (§4c's
299	  interactivity question, §4f's reinstatement) — absent from the DOM (not hidden) when omitted.
300	- `Close` renders top-right **only** for the wishlist variation, is a native `<button>` with an `aria-label`
301	  naming the product, hit area ≥ 24×24, and calls `onRemove`.
302	- Stock status is **out of scope for SFCC-236** unless the developer says otherwise — it is unmentioned in
303	  every AC, and its `Low stock` state contradicts `plp.md` §3's size-level placement. See OQ-12.
304	
305	---
306	
307	## 4d. Naming collision with concurrent work — RESOLVED (Marcel, 2026-09-02)
308	
309	Discovered mid-build, after Step 1 committed: `feature/SFCC-92_pdp-size-selection-add-to-bag`
310	(Jhoan Dela Cruz, commit `63cf6be`, same day, no PR yet, not merged to `develop`) already claims
311	`ZimmSizeSelector` at `ui-kits/molecules/zimmSizeSelector/` — a **dropdown** built on a new
312	`ZimmDropdown` atom, for the PDP's primary "choose your size" control. Genuinely different UI from
313	this plan's Step 2 (a hover-revealed row of individual chips on a PLP/Wishlist **card**), but an

245	          originalPrice={originalPrice}

Working on branch `feature/SFCC-236_product-card-shared-component` (confirmed via `git branch --show-current`; not `develop`/`main`). Implemented Step 1 + Step 2 of the DRY/drift-risk fix exactly as specified in the task, cross-checked against `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmerMANN-skills/.runs/SFCC-236/plan.md` §3 and the precedent file `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/zimmColourSwatchGroupShared.ts`.

### File created

**`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/zimmProductCardShared.ts`** — exports `CARD_SLOT` (the ten confirmed values: `media, badge, close, carousel, indicator, content, bag, price, sizeChips, notifyMe`, `as const`) and `HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY = '@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)'` (verified both pre-existing copies were byte-identical before typing this once). Not registered anywhere in `theme/components/index.ts` — correct, since it's a plain-constants module, not a Chakra recipe.

### Files modified (producers/consumers now import instead of retyping)

1. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/index.tsx` — 5 JSX attributes (`media, badge, close, carousel, indicator`) now `data-card-slot={CARD_SLOT.x}`.
2. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardContent/index.tsx` — 5 JSX attributes (`content, bag, price, sizeChips, notifyMe`) now `data-card-slot={CARD_SLOT.x}`.
3. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/zimmProductCardMedia.css.ts` — its private `HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY` const removed, now imported from the shared file. Confirmed it had no `data-card-slot` selector strings of its own, so nothing else changed here.
4. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/zimmProductCard.css.ts` — private `HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY` removed (now imported alongside `CARD_SLOT`). All 20 code lines / 36 value-occurrences of `'[data-card-slot="x"]'`-style selector strings converted to computed keys, e.g. `` [`[data-card-slot="${CARD_SLOT.carousel}"]`]: { zIndex: 1 } ``.
5. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/index.test.tsx` — imports `CARD_SLOT`; converted the file's 7 `document.querySelector('[data-card-slot="x"]')`/`container.querySelector(...)` calls to template-literal form.
6. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/index.test.tsx` — imports `CARD_SLOT`; converted 11 `querySelector` calls.
7. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardContent/index.test.tsx` — imports `CARD_SLOT`; converted 9 `querySelector`/`.closest(...)` calls.

### Verification of "byte-identical, only relocated"

For each of the ten values I ran a whole-codebase fixed-string count of the literal `data-card-slot="X"` before and after, and confirmed `before = remaining-literal-after + CARD_SLOT.X-reference-count` for all ten (e.g. `content`: 32 before → 12 literal remaining (all comments/deliberately-scoped test code) + 20 `CARD_SLOT.content` references). No value's occurrence count changed; only the definition site moved.

### Deliberately NOT touched (flagging for your review, per "do not touch anything else")

The task named "querySelector(...) calls" in the three test files as the pattern to fix. I found the identical literal also hardcoded in three other shapes I left alone, since none is a `querySelector(...)` call and none is one of the two named producer files:
- **Module-level selector-key constants** in the organism's `index.test.tsx` (`STRETCH_KEY`, `CLOSE_LIFT_KEY`, `CAROUSEL_LIFT_KEY`, `CONTENT_LIFT_KEY`, `PRICE_KEY`, `SIZE_CHIPS_KEY`, `NOTIFY_ME_KEY`, `BAG_KEY`, and their `HOVER_*`/`FOCUS_WITHIN_*` derivatives) — used as object-key lookups against the real recipe's output (`root[CLOSE_LIFT_KEY]`), not DOM queries.
- **Two `HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY` test-local mirrors** (organism + Media test files) — an existing, explicitly-documented "hardcode the literal the resolver produces" black-box precedent (matches `zimmSizeChip.css.test.ts`/`zimmTextInput.css.test.ts`), not named in Step 2's list.
- **Synthetic JSX test fixtures** building raw markup (`<div data-card-slot="content">`, `<chakra.button data-card-slot="close">`, etc., in the organism test's Fix 1/2/3 DOM-proof blocks).
- **Two `toHaveAttribute('data-card-slot', 'notifyMe')`** two-arg assertions (Content + organism tests) — not a bracket-selector string.
- **Prose/comments** everywhere (docblocks, historical fix explanations, `index.stories.tsx`'s two mentions) — left per AGENTS.md's comment-preservation rule and because `index.stories.tsx` wasn't named.

These remain byte-identical in value to `CARD_SLOT.x`/`HOVER_CAPABLE_QUERY`, so nothing is broken — just still independently typed. Flagging in case you want them folded in.

### Unrelated change already present in the working tree — not mine

`git status` shows `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/index.tsx` as modified (a comment-only docblock addition about a "Recently Viewed carousel" traceability gap, itself labeled "postbuild doc/traceability audit, comment-only — no behaviour change"). **I did not touch this file** — I never opened it with Read/Write/Edit this session. It's presumably concurrent work from another agent/session against a different finding from the same postbuild audit. Noting it so it isn't misattributed to this step or lost track of.

### Pass criteria evidence

```
$ npx tsc --noEmit
EXIT_CODE=0   (no output, no diagnostics)
```

Per your explicit instruction I did **not** run `npm run test` (or lint) — only the read-only `npx prettier --check` and `npx eslint` (no `--fix`) against the exact 8 files I touched, both clean, as an extra self-check that didn't stage or write anything. No files were staged or committed.
